column1: # What The Legend of Zelda: Breath of the Wild needs of an Android phone, for the launcher's readiness check (dm/games/README.md "Readiness rows").
# Placed memory fallback (opaque_fd mmap) and compute/CPU BC4-BC7 texture decode allow GPUs without hardware BCn or VK_EXT_map_memory_placed (such as Samsung Xclipse) to pass readiness.

column4: Memory: the game needs at least 6 GiB of total RAM to map the 3.2 GiB guest address space and shaders
Geometry shaders: needed by the game's terrain and geometry passes
Storage image writes without a format: used by compute and effect shaders
Storage image reads without a format: used by compute and effect shaders
Shader draw parameters: used by the game's vertex shaders
ASTC compressed textures: the game's ASTC textures are sampled directly by the GPU
Compute shared memory: needed by game compute shaders and BCn fallback decode
